description: This file is a PHP source file that serves as a web-based status and configuration page for network setup, specifically for displaying detailed connection and device info related to cable modem, MTA, and network status. It includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP code for collecting, processing, and displaying real-time network and device information, as well as data about downstream and upstream channels.
